messages.message: Use the Sandbox to run Python that prints the SHA-256 hex digest of the text sage-sandbox-check and the 25th Fibonacci number (F(1) = F(2) = 1). Report both values.
Sage wants to run the guarded action sandbox_exec. Accept approves; Reject denies without any reply; Respond denies the action and sends your typed text to Sage as steering guidance.

arguments.code_or_command:
import hashlib

# SHA-256 of "sage-sandbox-check"
digest = hashlib.sha256("sage-sandbox-check".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print(f"SHA-256('sage-sandbox-check'): {digest}")

# 25th Fibonacci number, F(1)=1, F(2)=1
a, b = 1, 1
for _ in range(23):          # already have F(1) and F(2); need 23 more steps to reach F(25)
    a, b = b, a + b
print(f"F(25): {b}")
